description: Replace handling of {:filament_observable_update, fiber_id, slot_index, value} (one per projection) with {:filament_observable_updates, [{fiber_id, slot_index, value}]} (one per server per notify_observers). Apply all slot updates in one pass before triggering re-render. Update unmount path to remove projections (remove_projection cast) rather than unsubscribing per fiber; unsubscribe only when all projections for an owner_pid are removed.
title: Update reconciler and LiveComponent for batched observable updates
